tree.heading: In general
tree.text: To effectuate the declared policy under section 6401(b) of this title, the Secretary shall issue and from time to time may amend, orders applicable to all fluid milk processors, authorizing—

children.text: the collection of assessments on fluid milk products subject to this chapter; and
the use of the assessments to provide research and advertising in a manner prescribed by this chapter.

tree.heading: Scope
tree.text: Any order issued under this chapter shall be national in scope.

tree.heading: One order
tree.text: Not more than one order shall be in effect under this chapter at any one time.
